2 Chainz revealed he got injured in a car crash
story.summary: In a shocking turn of events, rapper 2 Chainz was involved in a car crash on November 22 while navigating downtown Atlanta. He collided with another vehicle after having to swerve to miss a possum, resulting in two fractured ribs. Following the incident, he took to social media to share videos and photos of the wreckage.
